# `silk/json_array`

<!-- Generated by packages/compiler/scripts/generate-documentation.mjs. Do not edit by hand. -->

Profiles: `aarch64-apple-darwin`, `aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu`, `aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu-no-libc`, `wasm32-unknown-unknown`, `x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu`, `x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu-no-libc`.

Effectful JSON array construction through the ambient Writer.

## When to use

Use [`JsonArray`](#declaration-73696c6b2f6a736f6e5f61727261793a3a4a736f6e4172726179) to write a slice of values with a [`Serialize`](./json-codec.md#declaration-73696c6b2f6a736f6e5f636f6465633a3a53657269616c697a65) implementation.

## Details

The array owns its comma and depth state. It does not own or borrow the Writer.
A failed write can leave an accepted prefix in the Writer.

Import as `JsonArray` with `import silk.json_array { JsonArray }`.

Public declarations: 1.
